outcomeNote: Hadran plus an anonymous mishna; no inter-party act.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם נִילּוֹשׁוֹת אַחַת אַחַת, וְנֶאֱפוֹת אַחַת אַחַת. לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים נִילּוֹשׁוֹת אַחַת אַחַת, וְנֶאֱפוֹת שְׁתַּיִם שְׁתַּיִם. וּבִדְפוּס הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה אוֹתָן; כְּשֶׁהוּא רוֹדָן, נוֹתְנָן לִדְפוּס כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִתְקַלְקְלוּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The two loaves» that are brought on the festival of Shavuot from the new wheat are each made from a tenth of an ephah of fine flour. They «are kneaded one» by «one and they are baked one» by «one,» i.e., each loaf is placed separately in the oven. «The» loaves of the «shewbread are kneaded one» by «one and baked two» by «two,» i.e., two loaves are placed in the oven at the same time. «And» the baker «would prepare» the shewbread «in a mold [defus]» when he made the dough. «When he removes» the shewbread from the oven «he» again «places» the loaves «in a mold so that their» shape «will not be ruined.»

moves.summary: rules of kneading, baking and molds for the loaves

positions.claim: two loaves kneaded and baked one by one; shewbread kneaded one by one, baked two by two, in molds
